What is Drop Shipping?
Drop Shipping Business is a type of e-commerce business in which you do not have the products in stock but you receive orders.  So when the customers make the payment you just pay the MAIN SELLER and have the MAIN SELLER deliver the product to the customer.
NO STRESS!!
